title: The Reality Dysfunction
author: Peter F. Hamilton
summary: In the twenty-sixth century humanity has spread across the stars, with a wealth of polities and habitats. Then a supernatural threat starts to spill into that world, and a huge cast scrambles to react.
readIf: you enjoy very long, sprawling space operas with big casts and many storylines.
skipIf: you want a short, tightly focused novel or dislike grisly horror in your science fiction.
